name: builtwithjon
title: Built with Jon: Business diagnostic tools
description: Free, public, read-only MCP server from Jonathan Malkin, an Austin-based knowledge systems builder who helps owner-led businesses turn knowledge trapped in people and scattered tools into systems their team and AI can actually use. Tools: run a 3-minute business diagnostic, put a dollar figure on an operational leak (missed calls, slow bids, no-shows, invoice aging, and more), browse a 96-example small-business workflow library, read the decide-before-you-automate frameworks, get the Business Map offer details, and search ~50 articles.
